observations: This is an INCREMENTAL_UPDATE, not a bootstrap. Whether the group-radio-only click (without the child click) on a grouped_clipart field writes any placeholder value to localStorage before the child click, or writes nothing at all until the child is chosen — this finer-grained timing was not isolated in the source evidence (both clicks were performed within the same ~600ms window before each dump).
Whether field-level remount pre-fill (KB-020) applies to radio/clipart-type fields, or only to text-type fields as directly confirmed — only the Woman Name text field was checked for this behavior.

Full request/response body contract, auth mechanism, and error-path behavior of APIOP-051 (POST /api/merchant/shopify/customization) — network capture format used in this run has no headers/status/body for any entry.
Whether store1 (SDK v1) calls APIOP-051 or an equivalent endpoint at its own ATC time — store1 never reached ATC in this or any prior run.
